questions.question: Cite the source of the story and do not present it as an established episode in Kant’s biography: Martin Gardner introduces “How Did Kant Set His Clock?” cautiously with “It is said”.

localizations.source: Cite the source of the story and do not present it as an established episode in Kant’s biography: Martin Gardner introduces “How Did Kant Set His Clock?” cautiously with “It is said”.
localizations.ru: Укажите источник сюжета и не представляйте его как установленный эпизод биографии Канта: у Мартина Гарднера задача «How Did Kant Set His Clock?» вводится осторожным «It is said».

questions.resolution: The text now identifies the story as a logic puzzle rather than a documented biographical episode and cites Martin Gardner’s “How Did Kant Set His Clock?”, problem 51 in the 1994 Dover collection.
